push.on: Alerts are on for this browser
push.onBody: We'll alert you when it's time to leave, when you're called and when a visit changes.
push.whyBody: We'll tell you when to leave for your visit and when you're called, even when MediLink is closed. Your browser will ask for permission next.
push.denied: Alerts are blocked for this site
push.deniedBody: To turn them on, open your browser's site settings for MediLink, allow notifications, then come back to this page.
push.ios: On iPhone, add MediLink to your Home Screen first
push.iosStep1: Tap the Share button in Safari.
push.iosStep3: Open MediLink from the Home Screen and turn on alerts there.
push.unsupportedBody: You'll still see every notification here and by email. Chrome, Firefox and Edge support alerts.
push.failed: We couldn't turn alerts on or off. Try again.
